verdict.rationale: Slack's huddles docs say users can click the headphones icon in the conversation header to start a huddle. They also say huddles connect people over audio or video right in Slack, so calls start without leaving the app. missing for 10: explicit confirmation that DMs (not just channels) support starting a huddle, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can start an audio or video call directly from a channel or DM without leaving the app

citations.quote: Simply click on the headphones icon in the conversation header to start a huddle with your team.
Huddles happen right in Slack. Instantly connect over audio or video and share screens so you can get more done where you're already working.
